name: Inbox mail
description: Watch your mailboxes and put only what matters in the notification centre: one alert for a message from an important sender, matching your keywords or marked urgent, and one rolling digest per account for the rest. An Inbox panel shows all accounts together, groups the list by day, previews each message in one line, searches and filters it, opens a message body only when you click it — which marks that one message read — and changes the star, deletes or archives only the message you clicked. Each mailbox is either a known provider or a mail server you type in yourself (IMAP or POP3, TLS or STARTTLS); a POP3 mailbox is polled and has no read or star state. No model calls.
author: minih-git

en.name: Inbox mail
en.description: Watch your mailboxes and put only what matters in the notification centre: one alert for a message from an important sender, matching your keywords or marked urgent, and one rolling digest per account for the rest. An Inbox panel shows all accounts together, groups the list by day, previews each message in one line, searches and filters it, opens a message body only when you click it — which marks that one message read — and changes the star, deletes or archives only the message you clicked. Each mailbox is either a known provider or a mail server you type in yourself (IMAP or POP3, TLS or STARTTLS); a POP3 mailbox is polled and has no read or star state. No model calls.
en.safetyNotes: Reads the mailboxes you choose in Settings, and nothing else. There is no mailbox limit in this plugin: the slot declares none, and the app keeps its own safety bound of 100 accounts. Each account is either a provider this plugin names, over IMAP with implicit TLS, or a server you typed into the account form yourself — IMAP or POP3, implicit TLS or STARTTLS, on the port you gave — and that server is part of the credential instance: the app injects the password only into the endpoint stored in the same instance, so this plugin can never redirect your password to a server of its choosing. The app performs every sign-in itself: your password or authorization code stays in the app's credential store and is never handed to this plugin, which only learns which accounts exist, their labels, the email address you typed as a label, whether an account is filled, and — for a server you typed — its host, port, protocol and transport. A mailbox may also be reached through an HTTP or SOCKS5 proxy configured on that account — a local Clash on 127.0.0.1:7897, for instance. The app performs that handshake as well; the mail password still never leaves it, the proxy username and password stay in the same credential instance, and this plugin only learns the proxy type, host and port. There is no direct fallback: if the proxy fails, the account fails. Every account is polled and no connection outlives a check: once every three minutes the plugin opens one short session per account (IMAP: connect, select the inbox, look for new headers, log out; POP3: connect, STAT, UIDL, TOP for the headers of mail it has not seen, QUIT), never more than four sessions at a time and staggered, so it stays well inside the host's ceiling of eight TCP connections however many mailboxes you add. A POP3 account is never polled sooner than the server's LOGIN-DELAY. While watching, an IMAP account selects the inbox and for a new message fetches only its envelope fields, a few headers (sender, subject, to, cc, date, Message-ID, content type and encoding, urgency flags), its BODYSTRUCTURE (to know whether it has an attachment) and the first 4 KiB of its text with BODY.PEEK, which does not mark anything as read; a POP3 account asks for the header block only (TOP n 0, or a capped RETR when the server has no TOP). A message body is downloaded only when you open that message in the Inbox panel, one message at a time, on a short session of its own, capped at 1 MiB (a larger one is truncated and the panel says so), kept in memory for the panel to show and never written to disk; attachments are listed by file name and size and are never downloaded. In its own data folder it keeps one small file: per account the UIDVALIDITY number and the highest UID already handled (IMAP) or the UIDLs already handled (POP3, at most 500), the Message-IDs already reported (at most 200), the digest queue, the last error, and the envelope of the newest 200 messages (sender, subject, up to 20 to and 20 cc addresses, date, flags, whether it has an attachment, and at most 140 characters of plain-text summary taken from those first 4 KiB). The message body itself is still never written to disk. Opening a message marks that one message read, and only after its body has arrived: that is the one read change that happens without a click, and it is one IMAP STORE of the Seen flag. Clicking mark unread, or add/remove the star, sends exactly one IMAP STORE of the Seen flag or the Flagged flag on that one message. A POP3 account has no flags on the server: read there is a mark kept on this computer (at most 500 entries, cleared by mark unread), and a star is not offered. Delete and archive are the only operations that change or remove mail, and they act on the one message you picked: `inbox.delete` finds the trash with LIST (the special-use \Trash flag first, then a name such as Trash, Deleted Messages or 已删除), then sends one `UID MOVE <uid> <trash>`; on a server without MOVE it sends `UID COPY <uid> <trash>`, then `UID STORE +FLAGS (\Deleted)` on that one UID, then `UID EXPUNGE <uid>`; a server with neither, or a mailbox with no trash, is refused with a clear error instead of falling back to a mailbox-wide EXPUNGE, which this plugin never sends. Archive works the same way into a special-use \Archive mailbox (or Gmail's All Mail) and is offered only when LIST found one. On a POP3 account a delete is final: `DELE <n>` for that one message followed by `QUIT` to commit it, and the panel asks before either is sent. An HTML body is sanitized and displayed in a scriptless, origin-less sandboxed frame that loads nothing remote: remote images stay blocked until you press "show remote images" for that one message, and links are opened by the app in your browser instead of inside the panel. Notifications carry the sender, the subject, the time and the account, never the body. It does not send mail and creates no drafts; it moves, deletes or archives a message only when you press that button on that message; and it uploads nothing: the only network destination is the server each account is set to. No model is called at any point, so nothing you receive is sent to an AI provider.

zh-CN.name: 邮箱收件
zh-CN.description: 在后台盯住你的邮箱，只把该看的邮件放进通知中心：重要发件人、关键词命中或标记紧急的邮件各发一条提醒，其余按账号合并成一条滚动汇总。侧栏「收件箱」面板把所有账号放在一起，按日期分组，每封显示一行摘要，可以搜索和筛选；只有你点开某封邮件才取正文（并把这封标为已读），也只有你亲手点击才会改变星标、删除或归档那一封。每个邮箱要么是内置服务商，要么是你在账号表单里自己填写的服务器（IMAP 或 POP3，TLS 或 STARTTLS）；POP3 是轮询收信，没有已读和星标。不调用模型。
zh-CN.safetyNotes: 只读你在设置里选择的邮箱，别的一概不碰。本插件不设账号上限：凭据槽不声明 max，宿主自己保留 100 个账号的安全上限。每个账号要么是本插件列出的服务商（隐式 TLS 的 IMAP），要么是你在账号表单里自己填写的服务器——IMAP 或 POP3、隐式 TLS 或 STARTTLS、你填的端口；这个服务器属于那条凭据实例，应用只会把该实例的密码注入同一个实例里记录的地址，所以本插件无法把你的密码改投到它自己挑选的服务器。登录由应用自己完成：密码或授权码留在应用的凭据库里，不会交给插件；插件只知道有哪些账号、账号标签、你填的邮箱地址、某个账号是否已填写，以及自填服务器时它的地址、端口、协议和加密方式。邮箱还可以通过在该账号上配置的 HTTP 或 SOCKS5 代理访问——例如本机 Clash 的 127.0.0.1:7897。代理握手同样由应用完成；邮箱密码依旧不离开应用，代理的用户名和密码也留在同一条凭据实例里，插件只知道代理类型、地址和端口。不会回退直连：代理失败，这个账号就失败。所有账号都是轮询，没有连接会活得比一次检查更久：每 3 分钟为每个账号开一条短连接（IMAP：连接、选中收件箱、查新邮件头部、退出；POP3：连接、STAT、UIDL、对没见过的邮件取头部 TOP、QUIT），同时最多 4 条、彼此错开，所以不论你加多少邮箱，都远在宿主给单个插件规定的 8 条 TCP 连接之内。POP3 账号的轮询间隔不会早于服务器要求的 LOGIN-DELAY。在协议上，IMAP 只选中收件箱，新邮件只取信封字段、少量头部（发件人、主题、收件人、抄送、时间、Message-ID、内容类型与编码、紧急标记）、BODYSTRUCTURE（用来判断有没有附件），以及正文开头 4 KiB 供生成摘要，一律使用 BODY.PEEK，不会把邮件标为已读；POP3 只取头部（TOP n 0，服务器不支持 TOP 时用有上限的 RETR）。只有你在「收件箱」面板里点开某封邮件时，才会用一条自己的短连接下载那一封的正文，一次一封，上限 1 MiB（更大的会截断，面板会说明）；正文只在内存里交给面板显示，绝不写盘；附件只列出文件名和大小，从不下载。插件自己的数据目录里只有一个小文件：按账号保存 UIDVALIDITY 与已处理的最大 UID（IMAP）或已处理的 UIDL（POP3，最多 500 条）、已提醒过的 Message-ID（最多 200 条）、汇总队列、最近一次错误，以及每个账号最近 200 封邮件的信封（发件人、主题、收件人与抄送各最多 20 个地址、时间、标记、是否有附件，以及从这 4 KiB 里提取的最多 140 个字符的纯文本摘要）。邮件正文本身仍然不写盘。打开一封邮件会把这封标为已读，且只在正文成功取回之后——这是唯一不需要点击的已读变更，只发一条 IMAP STORE 写已读标记。点击「标为未读」「加星标」「取消星标」时，一次点击只对那一封邮件发一条 IMAP STORE。POP3 服务器没有任何标记：那边的已读是本机保存的记录（最多 500 条，「标为未读」会删掉它），也不提供星标。删除和归档是唯一会改动或移除邮件的操作，而且只作用于你点选的那一封：`inbox.delete` 先用 LIST 找废纸篓（优先 special-use 的 \Trash 标记，其次 Trash、Deleted Messages、已删除 这类名称），再发一条 `UID MOVE <uid> <废纸篓>`；服务器不支持 MOVE 时，改为 `UID COPY <uid> <废纸篓>`、对该 UID 发 `UID STORE +FLAGS (\Deleted)`，最后发 `UID EXPUNGE <uid>`；两者都不支持、或邮箱没有废纸篓时，会返回明确的错误，而不会退化成清空整个邮箱的 EXPUNGE，这条命令本插件从不发送。归档同理，目标是 special-use 的 \Archive（或 Gmail 的「所有邮件」），只有 LIST 找到了才提供。POP3 账号的删除不可撤销：只对那一封发 `DELE <n>`，再发 `QUIT` 提交，而且发出之前面板会先确认。HTML 正文经清洗后放进一个无脚本、无同源权限的隔离框中显示，且不加载任何远程资源：远程图片默认拦截，只有你为当前这封邮件点「显示远程图片」才放行；链接不在面板内打开，点击后由应用在你的浏览器中打开。通知里只有发件人、主题、时间和账号，没有正文。不发信、不写草稿；只有你点某一封邮件的删除或归档按钮时，才会移动、删除或归档那一封；也不上传任何东西：唯一的网络目的地是你为每个账号设定的服务器。全程不调用模型，收到的邮件不会被发送给任何 AI 服务商。

label.en: Custom server (fill in the address below)
label.zh-CN: 自定义服务器（在下面填写服务器）

label.en: IMAP/POP3 authorization code or app password
label.zh-CN: IMAP/POP3 授权码或应用专用密码

description.en: One per line or comma-separated: a full address (boss@example.com), a domain (@example.com) or a word that appears in the sender's name. A message from one of them gets its own alert.
description.zh-CN: 每行一个，或用逗号分隔：完整地址（boss@example.com）、域名（@example.com），或发件人名字里的一个词。来自这些人的邮件各发一条提醒。

description.en: One per line or comma-separated. A new message whose subject or sender name contains one of them gets its own alert.
description.zh-CN: 每行一个，或用逗号分隔。新邮件的主题或发件人名字包含其中任一个，就单独发一条提醒。

description.en: How long the rest of the new mail is collected before it becomes one digest entry per account. A single entry is updated instead of added again.
description.zh-CN: 其余新邮件收集多久后，按账号各自合成一条汇总。同一条汇总会被更新，而不会反复新增。

description.en: When on, messages that are already read in the mailbox are ignored, which keeps a second device's reading from producing alerts. IMAP mailboxes only: a POP3 account reports no read state, so this setting does not apply to it.
description.zh-CN: 开启后，邮箱里已经是已读的邮件会被忽略，这样在别的设备上读过的邮件不会再提醒。仅对 IMAP 邮箱生效：POP3 账号不报告已读状态，这个设置对它不适用。
